### **Key Fact Index for Shanice Wilson-Knox**  
*Organized by Label and Decade | Includes only distinctive, high-impact facts with dates and labels*

---

#### **1980s – A&M Records**  
- **1984** – Wins *Star Search* Junior Vocalist category at age 11; performs "Somewhere Over the Rainbow" and "Greatest Love of All"; wins $5,000 prize.  
- **1984** – Signed to A&M Records by John McClain after performing at Westwood Playhouse; joins *Kids Incorporated* cast.  
- **1987 (October 21)** – Releases debut album *Discovery* at age 14; peaks at #149 on Billboard 200.  
- **1987** – Debut single "(Baby Tell Me) Can You Dance" becomes a top-ten R&B hit (peaks at #50 on Hot 100).  
- **1987** – Single "No 1/2 Steppin'" also reaches top-ten R&B charts.  
- **1987** – Released from A&M due to label struggles marketing her young age.

---

#### **1990s – Motown Records**  
- **1990** – Signs with Motown Records in summer.  
- **1991 (November 19)** – Releases second album *Inner Child* internationally; peaks at #83 on Billboard 200 and #13 on Top R&B Albums.  
- **1991** – Lead single "I Love Your Smile" reaches #2 on Billboard Hot 100 and becomes a #1 hit in multiple countries.  
- **1991** – Nominated for *Best Female R&B Vocal Performance* at the 35th Grammy Awards (1993).  
- **1992** – "Silent Prayer" (featuring Johnny Gill) peaks at #31 on Hot 100 and #4 on R&B chart.  
- **1992** – *Inner Child* certified Gold by RIAA on May 26.  
- **1992** – Releases "Saving Forever for You" on *Beverly Hills, 90210* soundtrack; peaks at #4 on Hot 100.  
- **1993** – Releases "It's for You" on *The Meteor Man* soundtrack; peaks at #55 on Hot 100.

---

#### **1990s – Transition & Background Work (Arista/LaFace)**  
- **1996** – Begins performing background vocals for Toni Braxton (*Secrets*, 1996) and Usher (*My Way*, 1997).  
- **1997** – Makes Broadway debut as Eponine in *Les Misérables*.  
- **1997** – Signs with Arista Records; moves to **LaFace Records** at request of LA Reid.  
- **1999 (March)** – Releases self-titled fourth album on **LaFace Records**; lead single "When I Close My Eyes" moves from #91 to #16 on Hot 100 (then-record milestone), peaks at #12.  
- **1999** – Album sales decline after second single "Yesterday" underperforms.  
- **1999** – Tours as opening act for NSYNC’s *Boys of Summer Tour*.

---

#### **2000s – Hiatus, Re-emergence, Imajah Records**  
- **2000** – Dropped from LaFace Records after becoming pregnant with first child.  
- **2001** – Appears in film *One Special Moment*; makes guest appearance on *One on One* (Season 1).  
- **2005** – Re-emerges with single "Every Woman Dreams" (peaks at #62 on R&B chart).  
- **February 2006** – Releases fifth studio album *Every Woman Dreams* on **Imajah Records** (her own label).  
- **2006** – *Every Woman Dreams* peaks at #30 on Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums.  
- **2006** – Singles "Take Care of U" and "So Sexy" reach top 70 on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs.  
- **2005** – Founding of **Imajah Records**; name derived from her children: Imani and Elijah.  
- **2006** – Collaborates with PlayTyme Music (NY)
